1.title: Google Cloud Infrastructure Offerings and APIs
1.text: Welcome to Module nine: Google Cloud Infrastructure Offerings and A P Is. It covers the exam area All categories. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do six things. four point two Describe the functionality, business use cases and business value of Google Cloud's infrastructure offerings: Compute Engine. Modern application development. G K E. Serverless products (Cloud Run, Cloud Run functions). Products supported on multicloud and hybrid environments (Alloy D B Omni, Big Query Omni, G K E Enterprise, Cloud sequel, Looker). four point three Describe the business value of application programming interfaces (A P Is), including Apigee A P I Management. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Exam area: four. Modernize infrastructure and applications with Google Cloud (about eighteen percent). Exam format: ninety minutes and fifty to sixty multiple-choice questions. Validated against: the official Google Cloud Digital Leader exam guide.

1.title: Compute Engine
1.text: Compute Engine. Compute Engine is I A A S: virtual machines on Google's infrastructure. Business value. Full control of the operating system and software; many machine sizes; pay for use; good for lift and shift and specialized or legacy applications. Cost options. Spot V Ms for fault-tolerant work; committed use discounts for steady use. Scale. Autoscaling and load balancing across instances.

1.title: Modern application development
1.text: Modern application development. Flexible architectures such as microservices. Change and scale parts of an app independently. Managed services. Faster deployment; less operations work. Cost optimization. Pay for what runs; scale down when idle. Scalability and resilience. Handle demand spikes and survive failures. Operational efficiency. Teams ship features instead of maintaining servers.

1.title: Containers and serverless
1.text: Containers and serverless. The figure shows this: From virtual machines to containers on G K E to serverless with Cloud Run.

1.title: Containers and serverless, continued
1.text: Containers and serverless. Google Kubernetes Engine (G K E). What it is: Managed Kubernetes to deploy and manage containers at scale. Business value: Portability, automated scaling and repair, control over containerized apps. Cloud Run. What it is: Serverless platform for containers that scales to zero. Business value: Fast deployment, no cluster to manage, pay per use.

1.title: Containers and serverless, continued
1.text: Containers and serverless. Cloud Run functions. What it is: Serverless functions that run code in response to events (earlier named Cloud Functions). Business value: Small event-driven tasks with no servers. Exam tip: Container control at scale to G K E. Containers without managing a cluster to Cloud Run. Event-driven snippets of code to Cloud Run functions.

1.title: Hybrid and multicloud products
1.text: Hybrid and multicloud products. G K E Enterprise. Run and manage G K E and Kubernetes clusters across Google Cloud, other clouds and on-premises with one management view. Alloy D B Omni. Alloy D B (Postgre sequel-compatible) that runs in your own data center or another cloud. Big Query Omni. Analyze data stored in other clouds with Big Query, without moving it. Cloud sequel. Managed databases that also support hybrid migration paths. Looker. Business intelligence that connects to data in many clouds. Exam tip: The "Omni" products take Google Cloud technology to where the data already is. They support multicloud and hybrid strategies.

1.title: APIs and Apigee
1.text: A P Is and Apigee. An application programming interface (A P I) is a defined way for software to talk to other software. New opportunities. Expose and monetize public A P Is: partners and developers build on your services; new revenue streams and ecosystems. Reuse and speed. Teams reuse the same A P Is instead of rebuilding features. Apigee A P I Management. Design, secure, publish, monitor and monetize A P Is: security, traffic control, analytics and a developer portal. Exam tip: Apigee equals manage and secure A P Is and turn them into products. Do not mix it up with Compute Engine or G K E.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. A company needs full control of the operating system for a specialized legacy application in the cloud. Which product fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Compute Engine, which provides virtual machines. Compute Engine provides virtual machines with full control of the operating system.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. A team wants to run containers at scale with portability and control over the cluster. Which product fits best? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Google Kubernetes Engine, a managed Kubernetes service. G K E is the managed Kubernetes service for deploying and managing containers at scale.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. A team wants to deploy a containerized web app quickly, with no cluster to manage and a bill that falls to zero when idle. Which product fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Cloud Run, a serverless platform for containers. Cloud Run runs containers without cluster management and scales to zero.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. A company runs Kubernetes clusters in Google Cloud, another cloud and its own data center and wants one place to manage them. Which product fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: G K E Enterprise. G K E Enterprise manages Kubernetes clusters across clouds and on-premises with one view.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. An analyst wants to use Big Query to analyze data that stays in another cloud. Which product fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Big Query Omni for multicloud analytics. Big Query Omni lets Big Query analyze data stored in other clouds without moving it.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. A company wants to publish its services as A P Is for partners, secure them and track their use. Which product fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Apigee A P I Management. Apigee is the A P I management product to publish, secure, monitor and monetize A P Is.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. Which product provides virtual machines? Answer: Compute Engine. Question two. What is G K E? Answer: Managed Kubernetes for containers. Question three. Which product runs containers serverlessly? Answer: Cloud Run.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. What do Cloud Run functions run? Answer: Small pieces of code in response to events. Question five. What does Big Query Omni do? Answer: Analyzes data in other clouds without moving it. Question six. What does Apigee manage? Answer: A P Is: design, security, publishing and monetization.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Compute: Compute Engine (V Ms, most control), G K E (containers), Cloud Run (serverless containers), Cloud Run functions (events). Hybrid and multicloud: G K E Enterprise, Alloy D B Omni, Big Query Omni, Cloud sequel, Looker. A P Is: new business opportunities; Apigee to manage, secure and monetize.
